definitions.gloss: not applicable; not relevant; does not fall under (a category)
definitions.explanation: A checkbox or dropdown label meaning that a given item, rule, or category does not apply to the person or case in question. Common on government forms, applications, and legal documents as the opposite of {該当|がいとう} (applicable).

examples.japanese: {不該当|ふがいとう}に○をつける。
{該当|がいとう}・{不該当|ふがいとう}のいずれかを{選|えら}んでください。
この{項目|こうもく}が{不該当|ふがいとう}の{場合|ばあい}は、{空欄|くうらん}のままで{結構|けっこう}です。
examples.english: If this item is not applicable, you may leave it blank.

examples.japanese: {輸出|ゆしゅつ}{規制|きせい}の{対象品目|たいしょうひんもく}に{該当|がいとう}するか{不該当|ふがいとう}かを{事前|じぜん}に{判定|はんてい}する。
examples.english: Determine in advance whether the goods are applicable or not applicable to export controls.

notes:
Composed of the negative prefix {不|ふ} (non-) and {該当|がいとう} (applicability; falling under). Pronounced ふがいとう, not ふがいとう with a nasal — treat it as a simple compound.

USAGE:
A bureaucratic form-filling word. You will see it printed next to a checkbox or as a dropdown option on application forms, visa paperwork, tax forms, export-control documents, and insurance forms. In casual speech, people say {当|あ}てはまらない or {関係|かんけい}ない instead. The word itself is rarely used as a predicate in free prose; when it is, it takes だ or である: この{項目|こうもく}は{不該当|ふがいとう}である ("this item is not applicable").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {該当|がいとう}・{不該当|ふがいとう}: applicable / not applicable (as paired options)
- {不該当|ふがいとう}に○をつける: to circle "not applicable"
- {不該当|ふがいとう}の{場合|ばあい}: if not applicable
- {不該当|ふがいとう}{判定|はんてい}: determination of non-applicability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {該当|がいとう}: applicable; falling under — the positive counterpart
- {非該当|ひがいとう}: not falling under — a near-synonym, more common in export-control contexts
- {対象外|たいしょうがい}: outside the scope; excluded — focuses on being outside the target set, not on whether a rule applies
